integrity: Standalone Python verifier and saved output recompute finite face sets, acyclicity, integer Morse boundary, and mod-two ranks. No claim of external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The complete graph-classification theorem predates this calculation. Novelty applies to the integral homotopy classification and especially the Dürer case. Other graphs and parameters are not addressed; publication priority is uncertain; the original 1988 classification source was not inspected in full. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Complete higher-independence homotopy types of well-covered cubic polyhedra
